mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI (above 3.5% annualized) signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which pressures equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% annualized, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (above 7.5%) signals a weak labor market, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling economic slowdown and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST below 450.0) indicate weak residential construction, reducing consumer spending and economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 450.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained level of industrial production (INDPRO above 100) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 100, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.25%) indicates aggressive monetary easing, lowering borrowing costs and stimulating economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
